title: Vegan Black Rice Sushi Roll with Toasted Nori and White Miso Dipping Sauce

locations.name: Maui, Hawaii (inspiration; not confirmed shooting location)
locations.basis: Speaker cites Maui as the inspiration for the recipe; no explicit statement about filming location.

summary: This Goodful tutorial presents a vegan alternative to traditional sushi by using chewy, nutty black rice and toasted nori to form rolls inspired by flavors from Maui. Marie Reginato explains that bamboo sushi mats are optional, since the rolls can be formed by hand, and she emphasizes toasted nori for a firmer texture. The recipe features simple, flexible fillings like avocado and cabbage, underscoring that this is a nontraditional sushi vehicle for creativity. A dipping sauce built from white miso paste, sesame seeds, maple, and lemon juice (with optional fresh ginger for heat) completes the dish. The video celebrates colorful, tropical presentation and encourages imperfect rolling as a kid‑friendly activity, while highlighting the sensory contrast of texture and flavor offered by black rice.

sections.title: Intro and inspiration
sections.description: Marie Reginato shares Maui as the source of inspiration for these vegan black rice sushi rolls and frames the recipe as a home recreation capturing a bit of Hawaii in a meal.

sections.title: Equipment, nori type, and rice choices
sections.description: Discussion on rolling tools (mat optional, hand rolling acceptable), preference for toasted nori for firmness, and use of black rice for texture and flavor (white rice as an alternative).

sections.title: Rolling technique and imperfection
sections.description: Encouragement that rolls can be messy and imperfect, framing rolling as a playful, family-friendly activity with tasty results.

sections.title: Dipping sauce recipe
sections.description: Introduction of a dipping sauce combining white miso paste, sesame seeds, maple, and lemon, with optional fresh ginger for heat.

sections.title: Final presentation and ingredients inside
sections.description: Showcases the finished rolls with avocado and cabbage, described as a rainbow of tropical colors, ready to dip into the sauce.
